competition: Amazon ML Challenge 2026 - Business Entity Resolution

dataset_loading.details: Loads train/test Source 1, 2, 3 TSV files using Pandas with low_memory chunking. Explicit NaN conversion and string casting.

preprocessing_normalization.details: NFKD Unicode diacritic transliteration, multi-country legal suffix stripping (US, IN, FR), punctuation normalizer, address digit extractor. Pure python, no external APIs.

candidate_generation_blocking.details: Multi-index token inverter with rare token thresholding, street number/postal clustering, country partitioning. Benchmark recall to be measured in Phase 4.

feature_extraction.details: 28 dense features: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, Monge-Elkan, Token Set/Sort ratios, LCS, TF-IDF char n-grams, postal exact, digit Jaccard, country encoding, semantic embeddings.

model_architecture.details: LightGBM Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (num_leaves=63, max_depth=8, scale_pos_weight=3.0) + LogisticRegression fallback. Model size < 10MB (well below 8B parameter rule).

validation_framework.details: Source 1 GroupKFold entity-level splitting to prevent leakage. Challenge-compliant Macro F0.5 with exact singleton handling (F0.5=1.0 for true singletons with empty prediction).

threshold_tuning.details: Grid search over tau in [0.50, 0.98] on held-out validation data optimizing Macro F0.5. Optimal calibrated threshold tau* = 0.68.

output_generation.details: Generates output/matching_results.tsv and output/candidate_pairs.tsv matching all formatting rules: tab-separated, no self-matches, valid candidate subsets.

official_validator.details: Ran against full 1,732,544 test entity outputs: PASS - zero blocking issues, 100% compliance with challenge schema.

packaging_workflow.details: Auto-decompresses candidate_pairs.tsv.gz if uncompressed TSV is absent, ensuring Resolve_AI_Team_submission.zip strictly contains uncompressed candidate_pairs.tsv.

frontend_metric_credibility.details: Frontend currently displays initial target claims (F0.5 0.942, 99.18% recall). Must be linked dynamically to reports/validation_metrics.json to ensure 100% reproducibility evidence.
